changelog:
Initial public release of scrapfly-cli.

- Provides a unified CLI for web scraping, screenshots, AI data extraction, recursive crawling, and browser automation via Scrapfly.
- Supports output as JSON envelopes for programmatic use.
- Includes specialized commands for scraping, screenshot capture, AI extraction, site crawling, interactive/persistent browser automation, LLM agent-driven browsing, alerting on account metrics, and job scheduling.
- Offers broad configurability for rendering, anti-bot options, session management, batch processing, API use, and observability.
- Installation available via pre-built binaries or Go source.
